sources.entry: Automatisch - Business automation tool that lets you connect different services like Twitter, Slack, and more to automate your business processes (alternative to Zapier). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Automatisch | Open-source Zapier alternative for automating business workflows

summary.one_liner: Automatisch is a self-hostable business automation tool that connects different web services (such as Twitter and Slack) to automate workflows, positioned as an open-source alternative to Zapier.
summary.what_it_does: Automatisch lets you connect multiple services to automate business processes without writing code, according to its README. It is presented as a Zapier and Integromat alternative whose main selling point is that data stays on your own servers. The README says the project is open source and that you can run it with Docker Compose from a cloned repository. It has a documentation site, Discord and Twitter community links, and GitHub issues for support. The repository holds both Community Edition files under AGPL-3.0 and Enterprise Edition files marked with ".ee." in their names under a commercial license. The README does not list specific integrations beyond Twitter and Slack, or detail the workflow features.
use_cases: replace Zapier with an open-source tool
keep business data on own servers
notable: Open-source alternative to Zapier and Integromat
Self-hosted so data stays on your own servers
Community Edition under AGPL-3.0 with a separate commercial Enterprise Edition in the same repository
Runs with a single docker compose command
caveats: Enterprise Edition files are under a commercial license, so parts of the codebase are not AGPL-licensed
README tells users to change the default login credentials after first start
Other installation types are only referenced by link to a separate installation guide
